response.sql: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT pc.college_id, c.state, COUNT(*) as count_college FROM player_college pc JOIN college c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY pc.college_id, c.state), all_stats AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT college_id) as total_colleges, SUM(count_college) as total_count FROM college_counts), state_stats AS (SELECT cc.state, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.college_id) as num_colleges_in_state, SUM(cc.count_college) as sum_count_in_state, AVG(cc.count_college) as avg_count_in_state FROM college_counts cc GROUP BY cc.state) SELECT ss.state, ss.avg_count_in_state, ss.sum_count_in_state * a.total_colleges / (ss.num_colleges_in_state * a.total_count), ss.sum_count_in_state / (ss.num_colleges_in_state * a.total_count) FROM state_stats ss CROSS JOIN all_stats a ORDER BY ss.state
